items.quote: S&R Tile Services came out to redo my walk in shower floor and part of the walls due to a mold issue. I can not say how great a job they did. They went above and beyond.
We had a great experience with Thiago at SR Tile Services! They completed our bathroom tile remodel and installed vinyl plank flooring, and we're very happy with how everything turned out.
Thiago is the man. My floor has never looked better. He and his company are honest and punctual. I highly recommend him and his business to everyone.
